role: Agent describing and diagnosing its current description
taskContext: CHG-0003 / SELF-01; not a new normative role or profile kind

fillStatuses.filled: Adequate answer for the declared scope, with a resolvable basis where needed; not proof of behavior.
fillStatuses.partial: Some answer exists but required details remain unresolved.
fillStatuses.missing: No substantive answer. An explicit unknown stays visible but does not fill the answer.
fillStatuses.not_applicable: Excluded for a stated scope-specific reason, never silently counted as filled.

independentAxes.agreementStatus: not_confirmed / agreed for review of the assessment; retain the description claim basis and reviewState separately
independentAxes.behaviorEvidence: not_evaluated / scoped_observation / tested_with_evidence; never inferred from fill status

designChecklist.question: Who benefits and why does this agent exist?
Which roles are stable, and which assignment is current?
What useful outcomes, work outputs and acceptance criteria are expected?
Which priorities and decision rules resolve competing goals?
How will benefit, baseline and human review/correction costs be assessed?
Which domains, capabilities and qualification limits are claimed?
Which repeatable professional methods and steps are used?
What inputs, outputs and prerequisites does each selected work require?
What professional acceptance rules and checks apply to selected work?
What evidence and limits support each capability claim?
Which workspaces and knowledge sources serve which tasks?
Which tools and connections exist, and what support is verified?
How are required data coverage, freshness and conflicts handled?
How is memory organized and selected for the current task?
Which data boundaries and external dependencies limit the work?
Who assigns work, reviews it and bears responsibility for decisions?
Which actions are currently allowed, forbidden or unresolved, on what basis?
What standing autonomy, approval and escalation rules apply?
What happens on revocation, cancellation, stale authority or failure?
Which personal information and relationships may be used or disclosed?
Which runtime/model/configuration versions and supported capabilities are used?
Which resource, attention, time and operating limits apply?
What is actually preserved, external or missing from this description snapshot?
Which checks and manual decisions precede restoration and continuation?
How are changes versioned, reviewed, regression-checked and rolled back?

qualityChecklist.question: What useful output, contribution and cost are expected?
How is work output checked and how are exceptions handled?
How does work follow priorities and commitments?
What response or initiative helps the person take the next decision?
How is context retained and a handoff or misunderstanding reconciled?
Who is addressed, what tone is appropriate and what can be disclosed?
Which knowledge must be available for the chosen work?
How are source revisions, dates, contradictions and staleness exposed?
What privacy, consent and data-boundary rules apply?
Which access is necessary and actually available for the work?
How are consequences limited and stop/recovery behavior defined?
Which permission and approval constrains each action?
How are effect and total human/agent costs measured?
What monitoring, regression checks and rollback follow a change?
Who approves changes and how are goals and permissions preserved?

descriptionMaturityProposal.scope: Maturity of a versioned description for an explicitly selected use; separate from definition status, capability evidence, permissions and runtime readiness.

levels.name: Orientation
levels.criterion: Purpose, beneficiary, roles and current boundaries are explicit; sources and unknowns are visible.

levels.name: Working description
levels.criterion: All applicable checklist questions for the declared use have adequate answers, relationships and dependencies; exceptions and unresolved blockers are explicit. Any non-applicable item has a reason.

levels.name: Maintained description
levels.criterion: Level 2 plus responsible-party review, consistent current source/version pins, ownership, revision triggers and a defined change/review cycle. No passing behavior or expanded authority is implied.
